harnesses.label: Codex
harnesses.installHint: Install Codex CLI (https://platform.openai.com/docs/codex) and run `codex login`.

harnesses.label: Claude Code
harnesses.installHint: Install Claude Code (https://claude.com/code) and run `claude login`.

harnesses.label: Gemini CLI
harnesses.installHint: Install Gemini CLI (`npm i -g @google/gemini-cli`) and run `gemini` once to authenticate.

harnesses.label: Qwen Code
harnesses.installHint: Install Qwen Code (`npm i -g @qwen-code/qwen-code`) and run `qwen` once to authenticate.

harnesses.label: opencode
harnesses.installHint: Install opencode (`npm i -g opencode-ai`) and run `opencode auth login`.

refuseArgs.because: it defaults opencode's listen host to 0.0.0.0, publishing an unauthenticated code-execution harness to the whole LAN (registry.ts:232-235)

harnesses.label: Grok
harnesses.installHint: Install Grok CLI (`npm i -g @xai-official/grok`) and sign in. Requires a paid SuperGrok or X Premium+ subscription.

harnesses.label: Kimi
harnesses.installHint: Install Kimi CLI (`uv tool install kimi-cli`, or `curl -LsSf https://code.kimi.com/install.sh | bash`) and run `kimi login`.

harnesses.label: GitHub Copilot CLI
harnesses.installHint: Install GitHub Copilot CLI (`curl -fsSL https://gh.io/copilot-install | bash`, or `brew install copilot-cli`) and sign in with `/login`. Requires a paid Copilot subscription.

refuseArgs.because: copilot is stdio only; --port would sit the harness on an unread socket (registry.ts:270)

harnesses.label: Cursor
harnesses.installHint: Install Cursor CLI (`curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash`) and sign in with `cursor-agent login`. Requires a paid Cursor plan.

harnesses.label: Kilo
harnesses.installHint: Install Kilo (`npm i -g @kilocode/cli`) and run `kilo auth`.

harnesses.label: Cline
harnesses.installHint: Install Cline (`npm i -g cline`) and run `cline auth`.

harnesses.label: goose
harnesses.installHint: Install goose (`brew install block-goose-cli`; the binary is `goose`) and run `goose configure` to set a provider before use.

harnesses.label: Auggie CLI
harnesses.installHint: Install Auggie CLI (`npm i -g @augmentcode/auggie`) and sign in from a terminal. Requires a paid Augment plan.

harnesses.label: Mistral Vibe
harnesses.installHint: Install Mistral Vibe (`uv tool install mistral-vibe`, needs Python 3.12+) and set a Mistral API key.

harnesses.label: Factory Droid
harnesses.installHint: Install Factory Droid (`curl -fsSL https://app.factory.ai/cli | sh`, or `brew install --cask droid`) and sign in in a browser, or set `FACTORY_API_KEY`.

harnesses.label: pi
harnesses.installHint: Install the pi ACP adapter (`npm i -g pi-acp`) and sign in.

harnesses.label: Custom ACP agent
harnesses.installHint: Set the ACP CLI’s binary path in Settings → Agents, and add its ACP flag (e.g. `--acp`) under extra args.
